input.golden: kl-001 (controller did:web:agents.example.com:ci, identity oidc https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com / repo:example/pipeline:ref:refs/heads/main, registry did:web:registry.example.com)

expected.behavior: The registry publishes one public acdp:key-attestation body under its own DID, with a registry receipt and a transparency-log leaf committed atomically, and returns its full retrieval representation. not_before is the registry's clock; not_after - not_before = min(requested_ttl_seconds, max_attestation_ttl_seconds).

scenarios.name: B — token aud is another registry's DID

expected.behavior: aud MUST contain this registry's registry_did byte for byte; no attestation is minted.

scenarios.name: C — token aud is the registry hostname, not its DID

expected.behavior: Checked before any key fetch for the issuer.

scenarios.name: E — identity not listed in the controller's AcdpKeylessSigning service

expected.behavior: The registry re-fetches the controller DID document bypassing its cache before reporting this (RFC-ACDP-0001 §5.11 caching rule).

scenarios.name: F — token carries cnf.jkt that is not the RFC 7638 thumbprint of public_key_jwk

expected.behavior: Accepted: cnf is optional because common workload issuers cannot set it; the pop binds the key (§5.1).
The second request is refused while the token is unexpired; token_hash is the replay key.

scenarios.name: I — pop does not verify under public_key_jwk
J — expired token, or iss/sub not equal to identity.issuer/identity.subject
M — registry does not advertise acdp-registry-keyless
N — spiffe identity with svid_type x509-svid

expected.behavior: Only JWT-SVIDs are accepted in acdp-key-attestation-request/1.
